differences: The paper analysed 18 participants (two excluded for failed data acquisition, not identified); the deposit holds 20.

The sheet lists two trials for one Optotrak file of one participant (trial 5, 3.5 / 5 cm, and trial 4, 4 / 20 cm, both file 4); the stylus excursion in the file (about 20 cm) matches trial 4, so trial 5 has no recording and is left out.
Two Optotrak files (one for each of two participants) are not in the sheet (the participant's trial numbers skip them); they are not released.
The paper's end-effector and joint-angle measures (NL, AD ratio and others) were not recomputed.
